sections.title: Another -kozik/-kedik verb
sections.content: barátkozik ("to make friends, to socialize") is built on barát the same way ismerkedik is built on ismer — a noun plus a reciprocal -kozik ending. It conjugates as a regular -ik verb, exactly like the others you already know.

items.english: I like making friends with new people.
I'm open, so I make friends easily.

sections.content: szeretek barátkozni reuses szeret plus infinitive from A1 — the same pattern as szeretek olvasni or szeretek főzni, just with a brand-new -ik verb slotted in.
